526:t_2:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
(This is resonance between $$ウィスパード$$s...)

526:t_2:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'm seeing... his past right now...)

526:t_2:44.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's exactly what you saw.」

526:t_2:45.en:
$$レナード$$
「That day... my mother handed me over to the intruders who broke into our house.」

526:t_2:46.en:
$$レナード$$
「Whether they belonged to some organization posing as robbers to abduct me and $$テレサ$$, or Mother was trying to save at least $$テレサ$$...」

526:t_2:47.en:
$$レナード$$
「Whether I knew about her infidelity... None of that matters. My own mother denied my very existence that day.」

526:t_2:49.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$テレサ$$ doesn't know about this...」

526:t_2:50.en:
$$レナード$$
「And I didn't show you that because I wanted your sympathy.」

526:t_2:52.en:
$$レナード$$
「I have no intention of using my trauma to justify myself.」

526:t_2:53.en:
$$レナード$$
「I think and act of my own free will. My mother's hold on me has nothing to do with it.」

526:t_2:55.en:
$$レナード$$
「I opened my heart, just as you said... That's all.」

526:t_2:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...I don't understand. Why would someone like you want me...?」

526:t_2:61.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$カリーニン$$... Why are you with $$アマルガム$$...?」

526:t_3:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「They're putting up quite a fight.」

526:t_3:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「What will you do when you see him? Will you embrace him and run away together?」

526:t_3:11.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're hesitating. You wonder if you can return to him now, after turning your back on him even once.」

526:t_3:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even though he's risked his life to come all this way, you're still hesitating.」

526:t_3:13.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I want to see $$宗介$$... I want him to hold me...)

526:t_3:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
(These feelings are definitely real... But I don't understand...)

526:t_3:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Why aren't I desperately trying to escape...?)

526:t_3:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you're still unsure, let's make a bet.」

526:t_3:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「A bet? What do you mean?」

526:t_3:18.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll give you this gun.」

526:t_3:20.en:
$$レナード$$
「I said we'd make a bet, didn't I?」

526:t_3:21.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you really want to see him, shoot me dead and go.」

526:t_3:23.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll wait thirty seconds. Make your decision before then.」

526:t_3:24.en:
$$かなめ$$
(He isn't wearing that bulletproof coat... Right now, he's a defenseless flesh-and-blood human...)

526:t_3:25.en:
$$レナード$$
「You have ten seconds left...」

526:t_3:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If I shoot this man, I can go to $$宗介$$...)

526:t_3:27.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I hate this man... There's no reason to hesitate... All I have to do is pull this trigger...!)

526:t_3:29.en:
$$かなめ$$
(...There's no way I can do it...)

526:t_3:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
(This is probably my last chance to see $$宗介$$... I know that... I know, but...)

526:t_3:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'm not prepared to take someone's life.)

526:t_3:32.en:
$$かなめ$$
(It's so frustrating... He must have seen right through me before doing this...)

526:t_3:33.en:
$$レナード$$
「Zero... Your time is up.」

526:t_3:36.en:
$$レナード$$
「He fights to see you, and he doesn't even hesitate to kill people.」

526:t_3:37.en:
$$レナード$$
「Yet you can't even shoot one conceited bastard like me.」

526:t_3:38.en:
$$レナード$$
「In the end, that's all the resolve you have.」

526:t_3:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
(That isn't true. I want to see him right now... I want to throw myself into $$宗介$$'s arms right now...)

526:t_3:41.en:
$$レナード$$
「The bet is over. Now, hand me that gun.」

526:t_3:42.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Once we leave here, I'll never be able to see him again...)

526:t_3:45.en:
$$レナード$$
「How long will you keep being so unreasonable...?」

526:t_3:46.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I can't bear never seeing him again... Help me... $$宗介$$...!)

526:t_3:50.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I... shot him... I broke the rules...)

526:t_3:51.en:
$$かなめ$$
(No...! I didn't mean to shoot him! It was an accident during the struggle...!)

526:t_3:54.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I... I... I didn't mean to shoot...」

526:t_3:55.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...He's still breathing. Take him aboard and treat him immediately.」

526:t_3:58.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You're coming too. This place is...」
